My general opinion about art is that it always needs to be a value-add.  Some sources on the web are sketchy, but there are 7 primary sources that I think we should always pull from if available.

1.  Art by Ariel Burgess because she is the official WOT artist

2.  Art from the graphic novels - an authorized source

3.  Art from the CCG - another authorized source

4.  Art by Todd Cameron Hamilton from the World of Robert Jordan's Wheel of Time.  Like most people I do not prefer his work but since it comes from a published book it's "official".  

5.  Character portraits by Seamas Gallagher.  The guy does a great job and his work has been available for years.

6.  Chapter Icons.  They are in every book after all.

7.  Cover art from the books - both the initial runs and the newer art re-prints

After that I think we need to express caution when adding artwork.  There are good artists out there and others that aren't so good.  To make this Wiki the premier source for WOT info we want to make it appear extremely professional.  This is not to say that if an art source is not listed above it should be avoided.  But it must always be a '''value-add.'''
